task.title: CI/CD Deployment Strategy with Docker + GitHub Integration (Production Ready)
task.objective: Build a fully automated CI/CD pipeline where pushes to the `shyan` branch of the repository trigger deployment to a DigitalOcean droplet. Ensure Docker-based reproducible builds, correct environment configuration, and safe production deployment practices.

requirement.description:
Implement CI/CD such that:
- Every push to `shyan` branch triggers deployment. - Server automatically pulls latest changes. - Application is rebuilt and restarted using Docker Compose. - No manual SSH-based rsync deployment should be used unless explicitly justified.

There is an existing `deploy.sh` using rsync.
Action required: - Analyze `deploy.sh`. - Compare rsync-based deployment vs Docker-based CI/CD. - Prefer Docker Compose-based deployment for this scenario because: - Reproducibility - Version consistency - Rollback safety - CI/CD compatibility
requirement.decision_rule: If Docker Compose is available and functional, DISABLE or REMOVE rsync deployment path.

requirement.description:
Before deployment, audit all Docker-related files:
- Dockerfile(s) - docker-compose.yml - environment configuration files (.env, config maps, etc.)
Ensure: - No hardcoded localhost or development URLs. - All service URLs point to production droplet domain/IP. - Supabase endpoints and keys are correctly configured for production.
requirement.critical_check: Replace any: - http://localhost - 127.0.0.1 - dev URLs with production-safe endpoints pointing to the droplet or domain.

requirement.description:
Validate and update Supabase configuration:
- Ensure SUPABASE_URL points to production project. - Ensure SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are correctly injected via environment variables. - Ensure no credentials are hardcoded in Docker images or repository.

Implement CI/CD pipeline using one of the following approaches:
Preferred (recommended): - GitHub Actions workflow
Flow: 1. On push to `shyan` branch 2. SSH into DigitalOcean droplet 3. Pull latest code from GitHub 4. Rebuild Docker containers using docker-compose 5. Restart services safely 6. Run health checks
requirement.alternative: If GitHub Actions is not possible: - Use a server-side webhook listener on droplet - Trigger `git pull && docker compose up -d --build`

requirement.description:
Production deployment must follow this exact order:
1. SSH into droplet 2. Navigate to project directory 3. Pull latest `shyan` branch: git fetch origin git checkout shyan git pull origin shyan
4. Stop existing containers: docker compose down
5. Rebuild containers: docker compose build --no-cache
6. Start services: docker compose up -d
7. Verify health endpoints

Ensure environment separation:
- Production environment variables stored on server (.env.production or Docker secrets) - No dev credentials in production build - Explicit config injection at runtime, not build time

decision-on-deploy-sh.description:
The existing `deploy.sh` using rsync must be evaluated critically.
Rule: - If Docker Compose CI/CD is adopted → deprecate rsync completely. - rsync deployment is only acceptable for static or non-containerized systems.

deliverables.item: Full CI/CD pipeline (GitHub → Droplet → Docker Compose).
Cleaned Docker configuration with production-safe URLs.
Removed or deprecated rsync-based deployment if replaced.

engineering_principles.item: Infrastructure as code over manual deployment.
